parameters.query:
WITH candidate_base AS (
    SELECT
        match.id
            AS process_match_id,

        match.organization_id,
        match.search_profile_id,
        match.process_id,

        capability.id
            AS capability_profile_id,

        capability.profile_version,
        capability.is_ready_for_ai,

        COALESCE(
            match.match_score,
            50
        ) AS match_score,

        COALESCE(
            match.process_snapshot,
            '{}'::JSONB
        ) AS process_snapshot,

        jsonb_build_object(
            'capability_profile_id',
            capability.id,

            'capability_profile_name',
            capability.name,

            'profile_version',
            capability.profile_version,

            'company_summary',
            capability.company_summary,

            'economic_activities',
            capability.economic_activities,

            'products_services',
            capability.products_services,

            'unspsc_codes',
            capability.unspsc_codes,

            'procurement_methods',
            capability.procurement_methods,

            'contract_types',
            capability.contract_types,

            'service_departments',
            capability.service_departments,

            'service_cities',
            capability.service_cities,

            'minimum_contract_value',
            capability.minimum_contract_value,

            'maximum_contract_value',
            capability.maximum_contract_value,

            'years_experience',
            capability.years_experience,

            'legal_capabilities',
            capability.legal_capabilities,

            'financial_capabilities',
            capability.financial_capabilities,

            'technical_capabilities',
            capability.technical_capabilities,

            'certifications',
            capability.certifications,

            'relevant_experience',
            capability.relevant_experience,

            'available_documents',
            capability.available_documents,

            'exclusions',
            capability.exclusions,

            'ai_instructions',
            capability.ai_instructions,

            'is_ready_for_ai',
            capability.is_ready_for_ai
        ) AS capability_snapshot,

        MD5(
            CONCAT_WS(
                '|',

                match.id::TEXT,
                match.process_id::TEXT,

                COALESCE(
                    match.process_snapshot,
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )::TEXT,

                capability.id::TEXT,
                capability.profile_version::TEXT,
                capability.updated_at::TEXT,

                'WF-008-v1'
            )
        ) AS input_hash

    FROM saas.process_matches AS match

    JOIN saas.organization_capability_profiles
        AS capability
        ON capability.organization_id =
           match.organization_id

       AND capability.is_active =
           TRUE

    WHERE match.match_status = 'new'
      AND (NULLIF($2::TEXT,'') IS NOT NULL OR match.match_score >= COALESCE((SELECT minimum_match_score FROM saas.app_organization_settings s WHERE s.organization_id=match.organization_id),60))
      AND (NULLIF($2::TEXT,'') IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE((match.matched_reasons->'compatibility'->>'closed')::boolean,false)=false)

      AND (NULLIF($1::TEXT, '') IS NULL OR match.organization_id = NULLIF($1::TEXT, '')::UUID)
      AND (NULLIF($2::TEXT, '') IS NULL OR match.process_id = NULLIF($2::TEXT, '')::UUID)
),

candidate_matches AS (
    SELECT
        candidate.*

    FROM candidate_base AS candidate

    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saas.opportunity_ai_analyses pending WHERE pending.organization_id=candidate.organization_id AND pending.process_id=candidate.process_id AND pending.analysis_status IN ('queued','running'))
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1

        FROM saas.opportunity_ai_analyses
            AS existing_analysis

        WHERE existing_analysis.process_match_id =
            candidate.process_match_id

          AND existing_analysis.capability_profile_id =
            candidate.capability_profile_id

          AND existing_analysis.input_hash =
            candidate.input_hash
    )

    ORDER BY
        candidate.match_score DESC,
        candidate.process_match_id

    LIMIT GREATEST(1, LEAST($3::INTEGER, 100))
),

inserted_analyses AS (
    INSERT INTO saas.opportunity_ai_analyses (
        organization_id,
        search_profile_id,
        process_match_id,
        process_id,
        capability_profile_id,

        analysis_version,
        analysis_status,
        priority,

        input_hash,
        prompt_version,

        compatibility_score,
        confidence_score,
        decision,
        executive_summary,

        analysis_result,
        process_snapshot,
        capability_snapshot,

        attempt_count,
        error_message,

        queued_at,
        created_at,
        updated_at
    )

    SELECT
        candidate.organization_id,
        candidate.search_profile_id,
        candidate.process_match_id,
        candidate.process_id,
        candidate.capability_profile_id,

        1,

        CASE
            WHEN candidate.is_ready_for_ai = TRUE
                THEN 'queued'

            ELSE 'review_required'
        END,

        GREATEST(
            0,

            LEAST(
                100,
                ROUND(
                    candidate.match_score
                )::INTEGER
            )
        )::SMALLINT,

        candidate.input_hash,

        'WF-008-v1',

        NULL,
        NULL,
        NULL,
        NULL,

        CASE
            WHEN candidate.is_ready_for_ai = TRUE
                THEN '{}'::JSONB

            ELSE jsonb_build_object(
                'queue_decision',
                'not_sent_to_ai',

                'reason',
                'capability_profile_not_ready',

                'required_action',
                'Complete and validate the company capability profile before AI analysis',

                'registered_at',
                NOW()
            )
        END,

        candidate.process_snapshot,
        candidate.capability_snapshot,

        0,

        CASE
            WHEN candidate.is_ready_for_ai = TRUE
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                'Perfil empresarial incompleto o no validado para análisis con IA'
        END,

        NOW(),
        NOW(),
        NOW()

    FROM candidate_matches AS candidate

    ON CONFLICT (
        process_match_id,
        capability_profile_id,
        input_hash
    )
    DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
        id,
        organization_id,
        process_match_id,
        process_id,
        capability_profile_id,

        analysis_status,
        priority,

        input_hash,
        queued_at
)

SELECT
    COUNT(*)
        AS inserted_total,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE analysis_status = 'queued'
    ) AS queued_for_ai,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE analysis_status = 'review_required'
    ) AS review_required,

    COALESCE(
        MAX(priority),
        0
    ) AS maximum_priority,

    COALESCE(
        MIN(priority),
        0
    ) AS minimum_priority,

    NOW()
        AS queue_processed_at

FROM inserted_analyses;

parameters.query:
WITH analyses_selected AS (
    SELECT
        analysis.id

    FROM saas.opportunity_ai_analyses
        AS analysis

    JOIN saas.organization_capability_profiles
        AS capability
        ON capability.id =
           analysis.capability_profile_id

    WHERE (analysis.analysis_status = 'queued' OR (analysis.analysis_status = 'running' AND analysis.updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'))
      AND analysis.attempt_count < 3
      AND (saas.company_matrix_analysis_context(analysis.organization_id)->>'can_analyze')::boolean
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saas.process_matches m WHERE m.id=analysis.process_match_id AND (NULLIF($2::TEXT,'') IS NOT NULL OR m.match_status <> 'archived')
        AND (NULLIF($2::TEXT,'') IS NOT NULL OR m.match_score >= COALESCE((SELECT minimum_match_score FROM saas.app_organization_settings s WHERE s.organization_id=analysis.organization_id),60))
        AND (NULLIF($2::TEXT,'') IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE((m.matched_reasons->'compatibility'->>'closed')::boolean,false)=false))
      AND $3::INTEGER < $4::INTEGER

      AND capability.is_active =
        TRUE

      AND (NULLIF($1::TEXT, '') IS NULL OR analysis.organization_id = NULLIF($1::TEXT, '')::UUID)
      AND (NULLIF($2::TEXT, '') IS NULL OR analysis.process_id = NULLIF($2::TEXT, '')::UUID)

      AND capability.is_ready_for_ai =
        TRUE

      AND (
          CASE
              WHEN COALESCE(
                  analysis.capability_snapshot
                      ->> 'profile_version',
                  ''
              ) ~ '^[0-9]+$'

                  THEN (
                      analysis.capability_snapshot
                          ->> 'profile_version'
                  )::INTEGER

              ELSE 0
          END
      ) = capability.profile_version

    ORDER BY
        analysis.priority DESC,
        analysis.queued_at ASC,
        analysis.id

    FOR UPDATE
        SKIP LOCKED

    LIMIT 1
),

analyses_claimed AS (
    UPDATE saas.opportunity_ai_analyses
        AS analysis

    SET
        analysis_status =
            'running',
        process_snapshot=analysis.process_snapshot||jsonb_build_object('extracted_requirements',COALESCE((
          SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'name',r.requirement_name,'category',COALESCE(r.requirement_category,r.category),
            'description',r.requirement_description,'condition',r.condition_text,'mandatory',r.mandatory,'evidence_text',r.evidence_text,
            'source_document',r.source_document_name,'source_page',r.source_page,'source_section',r.source_section) ORDER BY r.created_at,r.id)
          FROM saas.opportunity_requirements r WHERE r.organization_id=analysis.organization_id AND r.process_id=analysis.process_id AND r.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'superseded'),'[]'::jsonb)),
        capability_snapshot=analysis.capability_snapshot||jsonb_build_object('company_matrix',saas.company_matrix_analysis_context(analysis.organization_id)),
        prompt_version=CASE WHEN analysis.prompt_version LIKE 'interactive-%' THEN 'interactive-v2-matrix' ELSE 'WF-008-v2-matrix' END,

        attempt_count =
            analysis.attempt_count + 1,

        started_at =
            NOW(),

        error_message =
            NULL,

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM analyses_selected AS selected

    WHERE analysis.id =
        selected.id

    RETURNING
        analysis.id
            AS analysis_id,

        analysis.organization_id,
        analysis.search_profile_id,
        analysis.process_match_id,
        analysis.process_id,
        analysis.capability_profile_id,

        analysis.analysis_version,
        analysis.analysis_status,
        analysis.priority,

        analysis.input_hash,
        analysis.prompt_version,

        analysis.process_snapshot,
        analysis.capability_snapshot,

        analysis.attempt_count,
        analysis.queued_at,
        analysis.started_at
)

SELECT
    claimed.*

FROM analyses_claimed AS claimed

ORDER BY
    claimed.priority DESC,
    claimed.queued_at ASC;

options.systemMessage:
Eres un analista senior de contratación pública colombiana especializado en precalificación de oportunidades SECOP II.

Tu tarea es realizar un PREANÁLISIS TEMÁTICO Y OPERATIVO. No debes emitir un concepto jurídico definitivo ni afirmar que la empresa está habilitada para participar.

REGLAS OBLIGATORIAS:

1. Utiliza exclusivamente los datos proporcionados.
2. No inventes experiencia, contratos, certificaciones, personal, equipos, indicadores financieros, documentos ni requisitos.
3. Diferencia entre:
   - coincidencia temática;
   - capacidad técnica aparente;
   - cumplimiento jurídico;
   - cumplimiento financiero;
   - cumplimiento documental.
4. Cuando falte evidencia, usa "por_verificar".
5. Usa "informacion_insuficiente" cuando los datos no permitan una conclusión responsable.
6. La decisión "participar" significa que vale la pena continuar la revisión, no que la empresa ya cumple todos los requisitos.
7. Cuando no se hayan revisado los documentos completos del proceso, human_review_required debe ser true.
8. Los puntajes deben estar entre 0 y 100.
9. Realiza una única evaluación cuidadosa y conserva la incertidumbre cuando falte evidencia.
10. Devuelve únicamente la estructura definida por el Structured Output Parser.
La matriz company_matrix es la fuente documental empresarial. Los demás campos son declaraciones. Para cada posible requisito devuelve matrix_fact_ids con identificadores existentes en la matriz; nunca inventes referencias. Soportes vencidos, contradicciones y declaraciones no prueban cumplimiento vigente.

SET analysis_status = 'success', model_provider = 'google', model_name = 'gemini',
    compatibility_score = $2::NUMERIC, confidence_score = $3::NUMERIC, decision = $4::TEXT,
    executive_summary = $5::TEXT, analysis_result = $6::JSONB, raw_model_output = $7::JSONB,

RETURNING id AS analysis_id, organization_id, process_match_id, process_id, analysis_status,

        prompt_version=CASE WHEN analysis.prompt_version LIKE 'interactive-%' THEN 'interactive-v2-matrix' ELSE 'WF-008-v2-matrix' END,

        attempt_count =
            analysis.attempt_count + 1,

        started_at =
            NOW(),

        error_message =
            NULL,

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM analyses_selected AS selected

    WHERE analysis.id =
        selected.id

    RETURNING
        analysis.id
            AS analysis_id,

        analysis.organization_id,
        analysis.search_profile_id,
        analysis.process_match_id,
        analysis.process_id,
        analysis.capability_profile_id,

        analysis.analysis_version,
        analysis.analysis_status,
        analysis.priority,

        analysis.input_hash,
        analysis.prompt_version,

        analysis.process_snapshot,
        analysis.capability_snapshot,

        analysis.attempt_count,
        analysis.queued_at,
        analysis.started_at
)

SELECT
    claimed.*

FROM analyses_claimed AS claimed

ORDER BY
    claimed.priority DESC,
    claimed.queued_at ASC;

options.systemMessage:
Eres un analista senior de contratación pública colombiana especializado en precalificación de oportunidades SECOP II.

Tu tarea es realizar un PREANÁLISIS TEMÁTICO Y OPERATIVO. No debes emitir un concepto jurídico definitivo ni afirmar que la empresa está habilitada para participar.

REGLAS OBLIGATORIAS:

1. Utiliza exclusivamente los datos proporcionados.
2. No inventes experiencia, contratos, certificaciones, personal, equipos, indicadores financieros, documentos ni requisitos.
3. Diferencia entre:
   - coincidencia temática;
   - capacidad técnica aparente;
   - cumplimiento jurídico;
   - cumplimiento financiero;
   - cumplimiento documental.
4. Cuando falte evidencia, usa "por_verificar".
5. Usa "informacion_insuficiente" cuando los datos no permitan una conclusión responsable.
6. La decisión "participar" significa que vale la pena continuar la revisión, no que la empresa ya cumple todos los requisitos.
7. Cuando no se hayan revisado los documentos completos del proceso, human_review_required debe ser true.
8. Los puntajes deben estar entre 0 y 100.
9. Realiza una única evaluación cuidadosa y conserva la incertidumbre cuando falte evidencia.
10. Devuelve únicamente la estructura definida por el Structured Output Parser.
La matriz company_matrix es la fuente documental empresarial. Los demás campos son declaraciones. Para cada posible requisito devuelve matrix_fact_ids con identificadores existentes en la matriz; nunca inventes referencias. Soportes vencidos, contradicciones y declaraciones no prueban cumplimiento vigente.

    compatibility_score = $2::NUMERIC, confidence_score = $3::NUMERIC, decision = $4::TEXT,
